==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Voted to the LJL Team for [[International Wildcard All-Star Melbourne 2015]] and [[International Wildcard All-Star Barcelona 2016]].
* His residency card issues with [[Rampage]] led to his sudden retirement in May 2018.
* Received the title of "Honorary Advisor" from [[Burning Core]] upon his retirement.<ref>[http://burning-core.com/news/981 Dara選手、引退。 (Japanese)] ''burning-core.com''</ref>
